beats: Unlock 100% of your brain, and you could fly. Move things with your mind. Even stop time.
There's just one problem. You're already using all of it.
Your brain is only 2% of your body weight, but it burns about 20% of your energy.
Your body would never pay that much to keep 90% switched off. Evolution would have cut it long ago.
Brain scans agree. Not every part lights up at once, but over a day, almost every region gets its turn.
So no flying. No mind powers. Just one brain, working all day. Follow Why Why Why for the why behind everything.
